learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to tell exactly where things are hiding!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The ball is in the box. This means the ball is sitting inside it!
The cat is on the mat. This means the cat is sitting right on top!
The dog is under the bed. This means the dog is hiding below it!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Play Hide and Seek!
fun_activity.instructions: Take your favorite toy. Put it IN a bag, ON a chair, and UNDER a table!

quick_recap: ⭐ ON means sitting on top of something!
